This should make imports such as `from pyaot.checker import check_source` resolve to the same file.

Since the tests are already set up and I just want a quick sanity check, I’ll run `pytest` on the `tests` directory, capture the output, and look at the last few lines (using `tail -5`) to see the overall result (pass/fail summary). This mirrors the earlier approach I used to inspect test failures, but now it will tell me if the shim worked.
